Spec Tracker

12.1 — CURSE OF ULA'TEK
Where every spec of WoW: Midnight stands — not one site's opinion, but every major tier list distilled into a single consensus with a ± wherever they disagree, layered with live numbers, sim profiles, and per-spec patch reads.
How to read itSeveral tier lists feed a computed consensus, with a ± marker where they disagree — flip between them with View, or pick Ours: 12.1 ✦ for this site's own Season-2 forecast (a projection, never a source). Filter by era or a specific fight, and click any row for the full read: patch changes, current numbers with ranks, sim fight profile, and community takes. Two tools up top: 📊 The Ladder draws any measured ranking as a chart, and ⊞ Compare all is the whole roster against every rating and rank on one screen. The ⚙ S2 Gearing tab is a separate explorer for Season-2 gear and loot sources.

· Overall is a 0–100 score, not a letter — 100 means every source gave its top tier, and the consensus reads S from 88 up. Tiers are within role: a healer's S is best among healers, not across the whole game. Open any row for its per-source breakdown. A ± marks a rating the sources disagree on.
PTR read — everything 12.1 on this page is early evidence, not settled fact.
what that meansSim numbers (Bloodmallet, SimC) desync between PTR and live and run immature rotations. PTR log cuts (WCL zones 52/54/56, Robydoby) are real player parses, but on tiny, tuning-in-flux samples (n often <100). Treat all of it as directional until ~2 weeks of live logs confirm it.
